events.title: Wolves on the Road
events.text: Grey shapes slip between the trees. A small wolf pack has picked up your scent and is fanning out to surround you.

choices.text: Climb a tree and wait them out (lose 2 days).
Throw them some dried meat (10 stones' worth).

ok.text: They snap it up and trot off.

events.title: Black Boar
events.text: A black boar the size of a cart crashes out of the undergrowth, tusks lowered.

events.title: Patch of Primeval Grass
events.text: Faint green light pulses from a hollow under a rock: primeval grass, thick and healthy.

events.title: Wild Gu Nest
events.text: A hum fills the air. In a split trunk, a cluster of wild Gu are feeding on sap. Capturing one takes skill.

ok.log: You coax a wild Gu into your aperture.

choices.text: Fight the swarm for their essence.

events.title: A Lost Merchant
events.text: A merchant with a broken cart waves you down. Bandits took his guards and he is far from the road.

choices.text: Point him the right way and go.

events.title: Bandit Toll
events.text: Three men step onto the road with blades drawn. 'Toll's twenty stones, Gu Master.'

choices.text: Bluff that your clan elder follows close behind.

ok.text: They exchange looks and let you pass.

events.title: Challenge on the Road
events.text: A lone Gu Master blocks the path. 'Your Gu look well fed. I'll take one.'

events.title: Moon Shadow Spiders
events.text: Silver webs glitter between the orchids. Something large shifts above you.

events.title: Thunder Crown Wolf
events.text: Lightning crackles along the spine of a huge wolf. It has noticed you.

events.title: Jade-Eye Snakes
events.text: Grass rustles in a widening circle. Jade eyes rise to meet you.

events.title: Rock-Hide Bear
events.text: A bear with stone plates for skin stands up, and up, and up.

choices.text: Leave it a gift of honey (one Sweet Nectar).

events.title: Demonic Gu Master
events.text: A cultivator with blood-red nails smiles at you. 'Your aperture smells delicious.'

choices.text: Offer a deal: you'll look the other way.

events.title: A Needle in the Dark
events.text: A whistle. A needle buries itself in the post beside your head. Someone wants you dead.

events.title: Sudden Storm
events.text: Black clouds roll in and rain comes down sideways.

ok.log: You meditate while the storm rages.

events.title: Abandoned Camp
events.text: Cold ashes, a torn tent and a pack left behind in a hurry.

choices.text: Search the area for whoever fled.

events.title: Primeval Stone Vein
events.text: A crack in the rock glitters with the green of raw primeval stone.

events.title: Scattered Ruins
events.text: Broken pillars poke out of the grass, carved with Gu formulas worn almost smooth.

events.title: Injured Hunter
events.text: A hunter lies in the grass with a torn leg, waving weakly.

choices.text: Bind the wound and carry him to camp (1 day).
Give him a healing herb (one Primeval Grass).

events.title: Wanderer by the Fire
events.text: A wanderer shares your campfire and, for the price of a meal, a story about a door in the mist.

fail.text: He falls asleep halfway through yours.

events.title: Passing Caravan
events.text: A caravan of the Merchant Guild rolls past and stops to trade.

events.title: Wailing in the Fog
events.text: A pale figure drifts through the miasma, singing a song with no words.

fail.text: The song tears at your soul.

events.title: Ancient Tomb
events.text: A doorway into the mountain, sealed with a formation that flickers when you approach.

events.title: Market Day
events.text: Stalls fill the square. Prices are good today.

events.title: Sparring Match
events.text: A clan cousin challenges you to a friendly spar in the training grounds.

events.title: An Elder's Lecture
events.text: An elder is lecturing young Gu Masters on the fundamentals of the aperture.

events.title: Pickpocket
events.text: A boy bumps into you in the crowd. Your purse feels lighter.

ok.text: You catch him and take back your stones, with interest.

choices.text: Let him go, he looked hungry.

events.title: Back-Room Auction
events.text: A broker whispers that a rare Gu is going under the hammer tonight.

events.title: Stone Gambling
events.text: A stall sells uncut stones. Some hold primeval essence; most hold nothing.

events.title: Information for Sale
events.text: An information broker taps the side of his nose. 'I know where a Gu nest is. 30 stones.'

events.title: A Refiner's Request
events.text: Madam Su needs three Iron Sand for an order and will pay well.

events.title: Arena Bout
events.text: The arena master offers you a bout. The crowd is already shouting.

events.title: Clan Politics
events.text: Two elders are quarrelling over who controls the clan's spirit spring. Each wants your support.

events.title: Spoiled Gu Food
events.text: Rats got into your Gu's food stores overnight.

choices.text: Buy new food (cost scales with your Gu).
Let your Gu go hungry for a while.

events.title: Travelling Healer
events.text: A healer offers to mend injuries for a fee.

choices.text: Pay 30 stones to heal all injuries.

events.title: {npc} Drops By
events.text: {npc} catches you at the inn with a jug of wine and a story.

events.title: {rival} Again
events.text: {rival} blocks your way through the square. 'Still crawling along at your stage? Pathetic.'

ok.log: You channel your anger into cultivation.

events.title: Lost Child
events.text: A crying child says her brother went into the woods to catch a Gu and never came back.

events.title: Black Market Whisper
events.text: A hooded figure offers you a Gu taken from a dead man. Cheap. No questions.

choices.text: Report the figure to the guards.

events.title: Dream of the Dao
events.text: In a dream you see your Gu moving like stars across a black sky, each one connected.

events.title: Aperture Turbulence
events.text: Your primeval essence churns, threatening to crack the walls of your aperture.

choices.text: Spend stones to calm it (scales with rank).

events.title: Aperture Plundering
events.text: A dying demonic cultivator lies at your feet. You know the forbidden technique to tear open his aperture and take its essence.

events.title: Blood Sacrifice Ritual
events.text: A cult offers to teach you a ritual that buys years of life with the blood of beasts, and some say, worse.

events.title: Soul Consumption
events.text: The ghost of an ancient cultivator offers itself to you. Consuming it would strengthen your soul and lengthen your life.

events.title: Longevity Gu Rumour
events.text: A merchant swears a Longevity Gu is hidden in a beast's den nearby.

events.title: Relic Gu Glow
events.text: Something gleams in a stream bed: a Relic Gu, rare and precious.

events.title: An Elder's Offer
events.text: Elder Chen watches you train. 'You have potential. I could guide your next breakthrough.'

events.title: Withering Orchids
events.text: The moon orchids of the valley are withering overnight. Elder Chen asks you to find out why.

events.title: Tracks in the Mist
events.text: In the valley you find grey slime trails leading to a cave behind a waterfall.

choices.text: Report back to the elder first.

events.title: The Rot Worm Queen
events.text: A bloated worm queen feeds on the orchids' roots, surrounded by her brood.

choices.text: Capture her with a control Gu.

events.title: Orchids Restored
events.text: The valley glows again. Elder Chen is pleased.

events.title: Jia Fu's Problem
events.text: Jia Fu is sweating. 'A Shang elder lent me money. I can't repay. Help me, and I'll make it worth your while.'

events.title: Following the Money
events.text: The debt was bought by a loan shark who hires bandits as collectors.

choices.text: Dig up dirt on the loan shark.

events.title: The Loan Shark
events.text: The loan shark meets you in a tea house, guards at his back.

choices.text: Pay part of the debt yourself (100).
Expose him to the Shang clan.

events.title: A Grateful Merchant
events.text: Jia Fu is free. 'From now on, you'll always get my best prices.'

events.title: Rumours of a Beast King
events.text: Tie Shan says a Hundred-Beast King Tiger has claimed the Wild Beast Plains, and the herds are fleeing.

events.title: The King's Pride
events.text: You find the tiger's lieutenants: two Thunder Crown Wolves.

events.title: The Beast King
events.text: The Hundred-Beast King Tiger steps out of the tall grass. The plains go silent.

events.title: Heat on the Wind
events.text: Smiths from Chi Forge talk of a fire beast in the caldera that melts their ore carts.

events.title: The Ember Tyrant
events.text: In the caldera a dragon-like salamander rises from the lava, crowned in flame.

events.title: A Wanderer's Riddle
events.text: Wen Rui speaks of three kings who left a blessed land behind, and a key broken in three.

choices.text: Ask how to find the shards.

events.title: The First Shard's Trail
events.text: Old Mo sells you a clue: the first shard lies with a bandit chief who doesn't know its worth.

choices.text: Spend two pieces of information instead.

events.title: The Bandit Chief's Hoard
events.text: The chief keeps the shard on a cord around his neck.

events.title: The Second Shard
events.text: The second shard is said to rest in an ancient tomb on Dang Hun Mountain.

events.title: Guardian of the Tomb
events.text: A guardian construct stirs as you lift the shard.

events.title: The Third Shard
events.text: The third shard is kept by Elder Ying of the Shang clan.

events.title: The Elder's Price
events.text: Elder Ying will part with it, for a price.

choices.text: Persuade her with what you know.

events.title: Forging the Key
events.text: Three shards, one formula. Refine the key.

choices.text: Pay Madam Su to do it (400 stones).

events.title: The Way Opens
events.text: The key hums and points toward a valley beyond Dang Hun Mountain.

events.title: The Three Kings' Trial
events.text: Inside the blessed land, three guardians stand before the inheritance.

events.title: A Rival Is Born
events.text: {rival} of the Bai clan is the same age as you, and the elders keep comparing you.

events.title: First Clash
events.text: {rival} challenges you in front of everyone.

events.title: Sabotage
events.text: Someone poisoned your Gu's food. Witnesses saw {rival}'s servant.

events.title: The Competition Trials
events.text: Both of you are chosen for a clan trial in the woods.

events.title: {rival}'s New Master
events.text: Word is {rival} has taken a demonic master: Hei Tu.

events.title: Ambush
events.text: {rival} and his master's men ambush you on the road.

events.title: A Desperate Plea
events.text: {rival}'s sister begs you to save him from Hei Tu before it's too late.

events.title: Hei Tu's Lair
events.text: You track Hei Tu to a cave on the Wild Beast Plains.

events.title: Choice of Blades
events.text: Hei Tu is dead. {rival} kneels, beaten. His fate is yours to decide.

events.title: Rivals No More
events.text: Years later, {rival} comes to see you.

events.title: A Fox in the Mist
events.text: A white fox with nine pale markings watches you from the edge of the woods, then trots away, looking back.

ok.text: Behind a curtain of mist, a hidden valley. The Hu Immortal Blessed Land!

fail.text: You lose it in the mist.

events.title: The Fox's Gift
events.text: In the heart of the Hu Immortal land, the white fox lays a cultivation Gu at your feet.

events.title: Verdant Great Inheritance
events.text: The Verdant Great Inheritance has opened! Treasure hunters flood the wilds toward a forest that wasn't there yesterday.

events.title: Southern Border Competition
events.text: Every hundred years the clans send their best young Gu Masters to the arena. Your clan has chosen you.

events.title: Heavenly Tribulation Storm
events.text: The sky splits. Lightning falls for days without end. Those who weather it come out changed.

choices.text: Shelter and wait it out (20 days).

events.title: Demonic Alliance War
events.text: Demonic cultivators have united and marched on the Southern Border.

events.title: Ancient Immortal Awakens
events.text: An ancient Gu Immortal has awakened and is seeking disciples, or meals.

events.title: Great Beast Tide
events.text: A tide of beasts pours off the Wild Beast Plains toward the villages.

events.title: Thunder Wolf Tide
events.text: Hundreds of wolves descend on Qing Mao Mountain. The clans must hold the line.

events.title: Grand Merchant Auction
events.text: The Grand Merchant Auction is being held in Merchant City this month.

events.title: Grey Plague
events.text: A grey plague spreads through the settlements. Healers are overwhelmed.

events.title: Blood Moon Eclipse
events.text: The moon turns red. Blood path cultivators grow bold; light path cultivators weaken.

events.title: Gu Yue and Bai Clan War
events.text: Old grudges boil over. The Gu Yue and Bai clans are at war.

events.title: Three Kings Land Stirs
events.text: A pillar of light rises beyond Dang Hun Mountain. The Three Kings Blessed Land is stirring.

events.title: Treasure Yellow Heaven
events.text: The Treasure Yellow Heaven, where immortals trade, opens its gates to you.

events.title: Sect Elder's Challenge
events.text: A Righteous Sect Elder senses your demonic deeds and descends from the clouds.

events.title: Dao Vision
events.text: For a moment you see the dao marks of the world itself, like veins in jade.

events.title: Golden Eagle Lord
events.text: A golden eagle the size of a pavilion circles, then dives for you.

templates.title: {adj} {thing}
templates.text: You come across {article} {adj_l} {thing_l} half-buried in the {terrain}. {flavor}

need: their Gu fell sick and needs spirit water
they need an escort through the woods
they want help capturing a wild Gu
their mentor vanished on the plains
offer: a scrap of a Gu formula
a map of a beast den
a rumour about a hidden blessed land
